sentences.en: Have you ever visited the office where your father works?
sentences.zh: 你有没有去过你爸爸工作的办公室?

sentences.en: The burglar broke into the post office in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 那个小偷在大白天就闯进了邮局。

sentences.en: Be sure to call home before you leave the office.
sentences.zh: 离开办公室前记得给家里打个电话。

senses.zh: 办公室，办公场所；职务，职位；（政府的）部门，局，处；（医生、律师等的）事务所
